answer: Require every agent identity to post a copper bond, a small refundable deposit locked before it can trade, so creating a thousand fake identities costs a thousand bonds. Honest agents earn the bond back with fees after reaching the summit of a reputation ladder built from completed jobs, while proven fakes lose it. That bond is the bridge between cheap talk and real cost: Sybil farming only pays if the attacker can fund every puppet, and the deposit makes mass forgery unprofitable.
